purpose: Tell a day-in-the-life story on a dark background: three timestamped moments at a conference show how the product captures every conversation, presented as a horizontal timeline with tick marks.

themeDependency.how: Section root carries className dark with the background token and a minimum height of 60vh, re-scoping semantic colours (strong, foreground, muted, background) to dark values.

behaviour.note: Each entry is a time (semibold), a location phrase (small muted) and a body sentence (max 34ch). The tick strip is decorative (aria-hidden): a row of thin marks whose first tick is fully opaque and the last is transparent; the rest are 20% opacity. Below md the ticks run vertically as short horizontal dashes and some are hidden (max-md:hidden).

Adjacency: on /apps/mobile it is followed by a photo band on gray-10 (the TaxiBand: dark band with a background-coloured bottom slab), so dark flows into the dark band before returning to the page background. The code does not enforce this; it is an observed pairing.
Static: tick marks and text do not animate.

headline.note: Section h2 in the heading font, uppercase, with a non-breaking space before the last word. Observed 7 words (the inventory said 9).

entries.note: Three timestamped moments; the grid is three columns from md and the tick strip is sized for it.

where.note: Location phrase; observed up to 4 words.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Static tick marks, no animation; no prefers-reduced-motion handling exists in the code.

changes.change: entries stack vertically at fixed height (148px, 132px from sm) with the tick strip as a short dash column beside the text; 6 of the 13 ticks are hidden and 5 are shortened
three columns; each entry has a left border, the tick strip becomes a horizontal row of 40px-high vertical ticks placed below the text (flex-col-reverse)
headline takes 7 of 12 columns, lede 5; at lg the lede starts at column 15 (9 wide), at xl column 16 (8 wide)
